hypothesis: V8 pairing after softmax was slower despite fewer fetch calls. V9 preserves v7 pre-softmax V loading and per-token accumulation; even token quads gather two rows and exchange the peer values using SIMD shuffle. Direct-exchange control isolates gather from sharing/scheduling.
primary: compact hoisted v7 to gather exchange v9, T8192, median ABBA/BAAB GPU ratio B/A <=0.85 in all five sessions
positive_criterion: At least 15% lower GPU time than hoisted v7 in every session, unchanged persistent memory, all fourteen represented-value attention gates <=1e-4 and exact gather-versus-read checks passed.
secondary: Direct exchange versus gather exchange isolates fetch instruction; v8 paired gather versus v9 exchange compares scheduling; own FP16 versus exchange measures remaining gap. No secondary comparison replaces the primary.
timing_design: Seeded ABBA or BAAB for four comparisons, random comparison order per block, ten warmup command buffers per variant, retain every sample. Five separately launched sessions, shapes shuffled per session.
scope: Same compressed payload, normalized values, affine metadata and Q/K. Same persistent resources. V9 restores per-token weighted accumulation instead of V8 pair arithmetic. Sharing texels can still change compiler scheduling. Source-level instruction count is not measured hardware instruction count or DRAM traffic. Precompressed warm repeated fixtures, not a model-quality, dynamic-cache or full-inference result. T2048 and T8192 repeat real fixture blocks.
